name: Gwinnett
schedule: First Tuesday (several times a year), Gwinnett Justice and Administration Center, Lawrenceville
note: Full results with winning bids and buyers are published for every sale from 2021 through early 2026.

auction.venue: In front of the Gwinnett Justice and Administration Center
auction.time: First Tuesday of selected months, 10:00 am sharp
auction.registration: Register in person at the Tax Commissioner's Office inside the Justice and Administration Center before the sale starts; registration opens two weeks before the sale and is not allowed outside or after 10:00 am. Bring the completed Bidder Registration Form with a current driver's license or other photo ID and arrive by 9:45 am to get a bid number.
auction.payment: Cash (U.S. currency) or cashier's check payable to Gwinnett County Tax Commissioner. Pay at the Tax Commissioner's office no later than one hour after the sale concludes.
auction.office: Gwinnett County Tax Commissioner, Department of Property Tax
vital: No bid number, no bidding; late registrants are held for the afternoon sale if there is one.
Opening bid equals taxes due plus costs; bids are accepted in whole dollars only.
The owner or any party with a legal interest may redeem for one year by paying the bid plus 20%, plus later taxes the buyer paid.
Sales follow the legal description in the advertisement, not the location of any posted sign.
The deed is issued in the Tax Deed Recorded Name on your form and cannot be changed; it is mailed certified to the purchaser.
A winning bidder who fails to pay may face legal action and be barred from future Gwinnett sales.
auction.confirmed: Page updated 8/3/2026; October 6, 2026 sale notice dated September 21, 2026
